name: com.tekivex/callbackcv
title: CallbackCV
description: Read and tailor resumes, export the exact tailored version, and log job applications against it — so callback rates are measured per resume version, not predicted.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_RESUME_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: CallbackCV API token, minted in Settings → API access. Expires after ~7 days. Not needed when connecting over OAuth to the hosted endpoint below.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_RESUME_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: CallbackCV API base URL. Defaults to the hosted API; override only when pointing at a self-hosted instance.
